notes.detail: Research-only data, not a complete verified slider extraction. Icy Veins live guide and database pages remained on Cloudflare verification in the browser; direct HTML also returned 403. Static extraction was readable, but it did not expose full slider states. Only explicitly attributed levels were used; every other point is "*". No point was inferred from prerequisites.

The complete Arms order is Method's two-handed leveling export, not Icy Veins. It was decoded from the guide's data-talent attribute and the linked calculator JS/data, using the recorded leveling suffix. Method allocates Spearing Strike at 28, while Icy Veins explicitly says 25; do not blend the two orders. Method's encoded order uses Lingering Rage at 46-50 even though its nearby prose mentions Unbridled Wrath.

All named points in the supplied Protection Warrior order through level 40 match Icy Veins' explicit level statements. No correction to those points was justified. Added the explicitly stated Reckless Swings at 59. Filler and other late levels remain unknown. A separately sourced, fully ordered Method Protection build is in warrior_paladin_evidence.json; it is a different recommendation, not a correction to Icy Veins.

Retribution uses Wowhead's launch-updated, explicitly printed level 10-60 order. Protection uses Method's leveling export through level 52; levels 53-60 were not specified. Icy Veins Protection text still refers to the older Improved Seal of Fury and is not used to supply missing points.

Only Holy Shock at 41 and Light's Vigil at 52 are explicitly level-attributed by the Icy Veins Holy milestone table. These are provisional source claims, not slider-verified picks. The other 49 entries remain "*". The page also describes Holy Conduit while discussing early Retribution pathing, so no order was inferred from that prose. Method's Holy page contains a raid/dungeon build rather than a leveling prescription and was not substituted.

A Forever Shockadin source DOES exist: Icy Veins describes a Holy Shock plus Champion of the Light hybrid in its Retribution talent guide. However, no attributed level-by-level leveling order was found. Wowhead explicitly excludes it from its leveling builds because it comes online late. PALADIN:shockadin is therefore omitted, not represented by a fabricated order.
Orders assume ordinary points beginning at level 10 and no Talented Legacy bonus. Do not blindly apply level positions to characters receiving early extra talent points.

spellIds are same-ability rank alternatives (OR), never a bundle of different abilities. Stance, Taunt and Sunder Armor are separate milestone records. Importance scores and spec filters are editorial priorities, not game data. Rank alternatives for Paladin abilities come from Wowhead's printed trainable-spell table.

Verified: Defensive Stance 71/10, Taunt 355/10, Sunder Armor 7386/10, Overpower 7384/12, Shield Bash 72/12, Tactical Mastery 1310185/14, Revenge 6572/14, Shield Block 2565/16, Victory Rush 402927/20, Shield Wall 871/28, Berserker Stance 2458/30, Whirlwind 1680/36, Pummel 6552/38, Recklessness 1719/50. Slam 1240193/20 and Berserker Rage 18499/30 are printed in Wowhead's Forever Warrior trainer table.

Righteous Fury is level 10, not the level 16 still printed in some guides. Holy Strike rank 1 at level 6 is 679, not 680 (the latter is rank 4 at 28). Blessing of Kings 20217 and Consecration 26573 are baseline trainer spells at 20. Flash of Light rank 1 is 19750 at 20; Divine Shield rank 1 is 642 at 34. Do not copy max-rank tooltip IDs as the only low-level unlock ID.

Seal of Command rank 1 is 20375 and is a Retribution talent, available from level 20 without bonus points. It is included in the selected Retribution talent order at 20. It is NOT a baseline trainer/quest milestone, so it is intentionally absent from spellMilestones under the requested quest|trainer schema. Higher ranks in Wowhead's trainer table are 20915/30, 20918/40, 20919/50 and 20920/60 and require the talent.

Redemption is the Paladin resurrection spell; rank 1 is 7328 at level 12. Quest rewards are The Tome of Divinity 1788 (Duthorian Rall, Human), The Tome of Divinity 1785 (Tiza Battleforge, Dwarf), and A Lesson in Divinity 94441 (Danitha Morr, Undead). The class guide links max-rank 20773, but this is not the level-12 rank.

Skyborne can be Warriors on both factions, but cannot be Paladins at launch according to Blizzard's race/class matrix. The new Paladin option is Undead. ChrRaces build 1.60.1.70707 confirms raceFile Scourge for Undead and Skyborne for both High Order (95) and Windshaper (96). Do not use display race names as filters. No Skyborne Paladin milestone or quest giver is invented.

The Skybreaker Bulwark is quest 94003: Seena Skybreaker on Zephras Isle sends Warriors to Zaal Stormshield. Although the class-quest guide lists only Defensive Stance and the item reward, the individual spell database pages list this quest as a reward source for Defensive Stance, Taunt AND Sunder Armor.

Client mount/player-condition data links Alliance Summon Warhorse 13819/40 to The Tome of Nobility 1661, Undead Summon Warhorse 1279399/40 to A Trusty Steed 94971, Alliance Summon Charger 23214/60 to Judgment and Redemption 7647, and Undead Summon Forsaken Charger 1296534/60 to Justice and Retribution 97185. IDs and levels are verified in IcyDB; race/quest gates are client data. Except the Alliance Warhorse hand-in, exact launch routes/givers were not recoverable. Icy Veins calls mount quest availability speculative and Method describes the 40 mount as a trainer spell, so mount acquisition confidence remains M.

Revenge tracking uses the 5-second Defensive State aura 5302; Overpower uses the 5-second enabling aura 1282733; Victory Rush uses the 20-second Victorious aura 402975. These are enabling-aura durations, not cooldowns. Icy Veins Arms prose says Bloodthrill enables Overpower for 6 seconds, conflicting with the database's 5-second aura; the database value is retained pending live testing. Usability-based detection remains an estimate and does not prove a lost proc.
No additional Paladin reaction-spell proc suitable for the existing usability-window tracker was verified. Passive Seal procs and execute-range availability are not treated as missed proc casts.

Warrior weapon-chain race restrictions follow Icy Veins class quests. Human/Dwarf Paladins have The Test of Righteousness and the Cloak of the Divine Storm chain; Return to Delgren 78093 is the actual cloak-reward quest, not A Strange Artifact. Undead Paladins have the Old Fire-Eye chain and The Moonsilver Blade 95126. The class guide says Wolfsbane is the final weapon reward, but its item database page does not identify the exact reward quest, so no additional terminal quest name is guessed.
